verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents AI-generated insights or suggestions inside Gusto. The updated Money Dashboard shows cash balance and inflows and outflows, but it is never described as AI-generated. The Dev Assistant MCP server and the agent-friendly CLI with a 'cash-forecasting' skill are developer and external-agent tooling. Those are building blocks or adjacent features, not in-product AI insights.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
